scope: paired teacher physics/recovery gates only, candidates never pooled; no student evaluation or training
raw_preservation: gcp1 persistent disk; lite evidence on local Mac; no independent full backup claimed
remaining_credit: UNVERIFIED, per coordinator billing exclusion; budget-stop binding guard

viewed_evidence.r2_view: not recorded by this solo r1 teacher; other robots visible in overview only
viewed_evidence.observations: solo target approach/perturbation camera loss-return/manipulation/setdown/lookaround sampled. Other robots remain separate; no observed mutual blocking. Integer-second review is supplementary to hash-verified result and command/evaluation ledgers.

limitations: Teacher gates only; no ACT student success, recording, training or promotion.
Live duplicate SIGINT cleanup and initially fully unseen branch were not separately exercised; source tests are separate evidence.
Direct video review is sampled: six runs, r1 own plus overview; r2 camera not recorded by this solo teacher.
First30 timing comes from review JPEG mtimes with staggered admissions, not an isolated steady-concurrency benchmark.
No host/SHA/profile/candidate pooling; no independent full raw backup claimed.
